excluded_alternatives: Abstract approximately 70 km is not a fifth independent survey width.
Section 3.2 normalized the four ADCP sections to 70 km to combine them with float data: this processing width is not a measured fifth section.
Summary 60–80 km is a rounded synthesis, not annual extrema; observed individual Table 1 spans include 48 km.

Reported average 62 ±9 km is not used: p.46 calls 9 km a standard deviation but the four listed widths yield about 16.0 km sample standard deviation; source statistic interpretation requires resolution.
The transport integration depth of 1000 m is not the ADCP-width layer.
Preliminary author poster (60–75 km and different transport) is superseded for these measurements by the original journal table.
Projection uncertainty is already represented in total error; do not add it a second time.
